name: ZCA_WEB_ACTY_RULE_CONDITIONS
description: This table ZCA_WEB_ACTY_RULE_CONDITIONS stores all  web activity rule conditions for the rules defined in table ZCA_WEB_ACTIVITY_RULES.

columns.name: WEB_ACTY_RULE_COND_ID
columns.description:
The unique identifier of a web activity rule condition record in ZCA_WEB_ACTY_RULE_CONDITIONS table.

This will be a primary key of this table.

columns.name: WEB_ACTY_RULE_COND_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number for a web activity rule condition record.

columns.name: WEB_ACTIVITY_RULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference to a web activity rule record in ZCA_WEB_ACTIVITY_RULES table.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT
columns.description: Source object on which the rule condition is defined.

columns.name: RULE_CONDITION_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: The Rule condition group to which this rule condition record belongs to.

columns.name: RULE_CONDITION_GROUP_TYPE
columns.description: The type of Rule condition group which can be either INCLUSION or EXCLUSION.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
